question.text: How can an electrochemical cell be converted into an electrolytic cell?

options.text: Applying an external opposite potential lower than \(\mathrm{E}^0\) cell.
Reversing the flow of ions in salt bridge.
Applying an external opposite potential greater than \(\mathrm{E}^0\) cell-
Exchanging the electrodes at anode and cathode.

solution.text: Applied external potential should be greater than $\mathrm{E}_{\text {cell }}^0$ in opposite direction.
